chunks: Ibn Abi Umayr from Yunus ibn Ya'qub said:
He said to me: 'Help them in the construction of a mosque.'
ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about helping build a mosque?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) instructs his companion to assist others in building a mosque, highlighting the virtue of cooperation in religious construction. This narration is often cited in discussions regarding the permissibility and merit of contributing to mosque construction, reflecting the Shia emphasis on communal worship spaces as centers of spiritual and social cohesion.
